Hi Samir —

Quick technical answers and what we’re attaching to the bundle: please see the attached zip (redwood-sigs-and-reports.zip) — it contains the latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), our completed SIG questionnaire, and our CAIQ matrix. Additional details below:

1) EU-only processing: For hosted deployments we can pin inference to EU regions (we operate in multiple cloud regions; for Acme we will restrict compute and persistent storage to eu-west-1 and eu-west-3 nodes). For Dedicated and Private modes we deploy into customer VPCs or VPC-peer-connected subnets so compute and KV caches remain inside your VPC. We also provide an architecture attestation that backups and snapshots are either disabled or stored to EU-only buckets per contract.

2) Networking — options: 
   - PrivateLink (recommended): our PrivateLink endpoint exposes the inference API into your VPC without cross-AZ NAT traversal.
   - VPC Peering: supported for Dedicated pools, with explicit CIDR ACLs.
   - IPSec VPN: available for on-prem early pilots.

3) KMS/BYOK and HSM: we support customer-managed KMS keys in EU regions with envelope encryption on all persistent stores. We can integrate with your cloud KMS (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault) and we support HSM-backed key policies for keys that require FIPS/HSM assurances. Key material never leaves your control plane; keys are referenced by ARN/URL from within our runtime when you configure BYOK.

4) Audit trail and retention: we emit tenant-scoped audit logs for admin actions, access tokens, and model deployments. Logs are exportable to your SIEM and can be retained per contract; standard retention available is 12 months with optional longer retention as an add-on.

Attachments in the bundle (high level):
- SOC2_Redacted_2026_TypeII.pdf
- Redwood_CAiq_Matrix_2026.xlsx
- Region_Hosting_Matrix.csv
- Architecture_Attestation_EU.pdf

We’ll also add a network-topology diagram (network-topology-eu-private-link.pdf) and a short sample contract clause for data residency.

If you want legal wording for the data-residency guarantee (for inclusion in the SOW), Laura — can you attach the sample clause in the next reply?

-Neha
